{"verdict":"concerns","items":[{"file":"src/diff.cho","line":109,"claim":"`total / 2 + grown / 2` truncates each half separately; `total` and `grown` always have the same parity, so when both are odd the result is one too small, e.g. `diff_stat(heap, \"\", \"x\\n\")` gives (0, 1) instead of (1, 0)."},{"file":"src/diff.cho","line":109,"claim":"The correct formula is `(total + grown) / 2`; with the split form, inputs like total=5, grown=3 give added=3 and removed=2 instead of 4 and 1, so the pair is wrong whenever the line count changes by an odd amount."},{"file":"tests/diff_test.cho","line":232,"claim":"All five `diff_stat` tests have an even `total` (2, 2, 3 with grown -3 where truncation happens to hide the bug, 2, 4), so no test covers the odd-sum case with a positive growth, e.g. adding one line to an empty text, and the bug above passes."}]}
